Facebook, Inc. provides various products to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, and other surfaces worldwide. The company has market cap of $537.65 billion. The Company’s solutions include Facebook Website and mobile application that enables people to connect, share, discover, and communicate each other on mobile devices and personal computers; Instagram, a mobile application that enables people to take photos or videos, customize them with filter effects, and share them with friends and followers in a photo feed or send them directly to friends; Messenger, a messaging application to communicate with people and businesses across platforms and devices; and WhatsApp Messenger, a mobile messaging application. It has a 30.75 P/E ratio. The firm also offers Oculus virtual reality technology and content platform, which allow people to enter an immersive and interactive environment to play games, consume content, and connect with others.
Analysts await Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) to report earnings on July, 25. They expect $1.72 EPS, up 30.30% or $0.40 from last year’s $1.32 per share. FB’s profit will be $4.98 billion for 27.00 P/E if the $1.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.69 actual EPS reported by Facebook, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 1.78% EPS growth.
Mr. Mark Zuckerberg, the present COB and CEO at Facebook Inc has not a long ago been connected with an open market sale of 440,000 shares of the California-based Facebook Inc, valued at $185.6 per share. The transaction value was of $81,680,812 US Dollars. In the last 30 days, he also sold 4,259,082 shares worth approximately $769,088,052 USD. This stock deal by Mr. Mark – was dated on May 29, 2018 and revealed in a SEC’s filing available here . Currently, Mr. Mark, has ownership of 18.29 million shares, which accounts for 10%+ of the Company’s market cap. The insider’s activity definitely generated quite an interest in the stock community.
